The main takeaway from our work is that

the hot dense matter created in heavy ion collisions can be described as a non-equilibrium system with a non-trivial energy density, pressure, pressure anisotropies, and chemical potentials, which can be studied using the multi-phase transport model.
the bulk properties of hot dense matter in the collisions are sensitive to the details of the non-equilibrium dynamics in the collisions.
